lamps.steady: Parking brake applied, low brake fluid level, or brake malfunction. Stop safely and contact workshop.

lamps.lamp: Driver and Front Passenger Seat Belt Reminder Light
lamps.steady: Driver or front passenger seat belt is unfastened. Fasten seat belt.

lamps.lamp: Rear Seat Passenger Seat Belt Reminder Light
lamps.steady: Rear seat passenger seat belt is unfastened. Fasten seat belt.
Fuel level is around 5.0L or less. Fill fuel tank immediately.
ABS malfunction. Pull off road, restart engine; if light stays on, consult authorized workshop.
Emission control system needs servicing. Have vehicle checked by authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Damage detected in emission control system. Have vehicle repaired at authorized workshop.

lamps.steady: Electric power steering malfunction or system check. Consult an authorized workshop.
Insufficient engine oil pressure. Pull off road, stop engine, check oil, and consult workshop.
Battery charging system malfunction. Inspect immediately at an authorized workshop.
Automatic transmission system malfunction. Stop safely and contact authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Automatic transmission system malfunction. Stop in a safe place and contact workshop.

lamps.lamp: Immobilizer / Keyless Push Start System Warning Light
lamps.steady: System malfunction or key outside vehicle range. Check remote location or consult workshop.
lamps.flashing: System problem or key controller outside vehicle. Place controller inside or inspect at workshop.

lamps.steady: One or more doors or tailgate are open. Close all doors completely.
Warning message on information display. Read message and follow instructions.
lamps.flashing: Warning message displayed, key error, or electric parking brake issue. Check display.

lamps.steady: One or more tyres significantly under-inflated. Stop and inflate tyres to correct pressure.
lamps.flashing: TPMS malfunction. Have vehicle inspected by an authorized workshop.

lamps.steady: Hybrid system malfunction. Consult Maruti Suzuki authorized workshop.

lamps.lamp: High Engine Coolant Temperature Warning Light
lamps.steady: Engine overheating. Stop driving immediately and follow emergency instructions.
lamps.flashing: Engine running hot. Follow overheating emergency instructions.

lamps.steady: Malfunction in airbag or seat belt pretensioner system. Have inspected at workshop.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction in airbag or seat belt pretensioner system. Inspect at workshop.

lamps.steady: High beam headlights are switched on.
Position lights or instrument panel illumination is turned on.
ESP system (except ABS) is turned off using ESP OFF switch.
ESP system malfunction. Have system inspected by an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: ESP system is actively operating. Drive carefully.

lamps.lamp: Electric Parking Brake Operation Indicator Light
lamps.steady: Electric parking brake is currently engaged.
Brake hold system is actively applying brakes.
Brake hold system is switched on and in standby.
Engine has automatically stopped via ENG A-STOP.
lamps.flashing: Driver door opened or seat belt unfastened during auto stop. Close door and fasten belt.

lamps.steady: ENG A-STOP system is deactivated.
lamps.flashing: System problem, battery issue, or lead-acid battery replacement required. Inspect at workshop.

lamps.steady: 4WD system malfunction. System deactivated automatically. Have inspected at workshop.
lamps.flashing: Drive train component overheating or uneven wheel sizes. Move to safe place and run engine idle.

lamps.steady: Hill descent control switch turned on and operating conditions met.
lamps.flashing: Operating conditions not met or system malfunction. Check conditions or consult workshop.

lamps.steady: Vehicle driven using electric motor or engine is stopped.
